Control over game data

MapBop does not require a separate Oyri Games account in the current build. Local saves stay on your device. The options below explain how to manage game data, service permissions, and support requests.

Advertising and tracking choices

Manage app tracking permission and advertising identifier controls in device settings. Where the game offers an ad privacy or consent screen, use it to change available preferences. Options vary by platform and region. Non-personalized ads can still process technical data for delivery and fraud prevention.

Access, correction, and deletion

Use the support address to ask about game-related data, request access, or request deletion. Include the game name and platform. Provide the relevant installation identifier if known; do not send passwords or card details.
